name: tokenization-factory
description: Skills for issuers using Sara Tokenization Factory: build the project document, prepare an indicative asset valuation, plan launch and visibility, onboard holders and create holder updates.

interface.longDescription: Create evidence-based tokenization project documents, indicative asset valuations, launch materials, listing and visibility plans, holder-onboarding workflows, and holder updates. Intended for issuers using Sara Tokenization Factory. Outputs are drafts, plans and analytical estimates, not legal, tax, investment, audit, independent valuation, or offering advice.
defaultPrompt: Hi Sara — here is my token: https://sarawallet.com/tokenize/token/<contract-address>.json
Create the complete project legal-document pack for my tokenized asset now, with a linked table of contents. Mark missing facts as open items rather than stopping to ask questions.
Calculate an evidence-based indicative valuation range for my asset and show the assumptions, methods, sensitivities and attributable amount per token if supportable.
Assess promotion constraints and build a launch kit for my token.

publication.release_notes: Adds an asset-valuation skill that calculates transparent indicative valuation ranges, sensitivities and attributable per-token amounts where the legal and economic inputs support them.
